_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 106 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: PTKM-1R

description.text: An anti-vehicle mine that locates targets in the immediate area via audio sensors. Once triggered, it launches an explosive payload and performs a top-down attack to strike armored vehicles where they are less protected.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
